descriptionAdvanced.de: Kennington ist ein attraktiver Vorort von Ashford in der Grafschaft Kent und blickt auf eine über tausendjährige Geschichte zurück. Bereits im Domesday Book von 1086 als 'Chenentone' erwähnt, war es ursprünglich ein eigenständiges Dorf, das im Laufe des 20. Jahrhunderts mit der expandierenden Stadt Ashford verschmolz. Die Geografie des Ortes wird durch das malerische Stour-Tal bestimmt, das Kennington eine grüne und waldreiche Umgebung verleiht. Ein zentrales Wahrzeichen ist die Kirche St. Mary, ein beeindruckendes Bauwerk aus dem 13. Jahrhundert, das das historische Herz des Ortes bildet. Wirtschaftlich hat sich Kennington von einer agrarisch geprägten Siedlung zu einer bevorzugten Wohnlage entwickelt, die von der hervorragenden Verkehrsanbindung an London und den Kontinent über den Bahnhof Ashford International profitiert. Trotz der Nähe zur Autobahn M20 hat sich Kennington einen dörflichen Charme bewahrt, der durch lokale Pubs, weite Parks wie den Ball Lane Park und traditionelle Cricket-Plätze unterstrichen wird.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Kennington Ashford városának egyik legkeresettebb és legpatinásabb lakóövezete Kent megyében. A település gyökerei a szász időkig nyúlnak vissza, neve pedig a 11. századi Domesday Bookban is feltűnik Chenentone alakban. Földrajzi elhelyezkedése kedvező, hiszen a Great Stour folyó völgyében fekszik, dombos és erdős területekkel övezve. A közösség központja évszázadok óta a Szent Mária-templom, amelynek tornya messziről látható az Ashfordba vezető utak mentén. Kennington fejlődése a 20. században gyorsult fel, amikor a vasút és az ipar közelsége miatt fontos elővárossá vált, ám sikerült megőriznie eredeti falusi jellegét. A területen több jelentős történelmi kúria és udvarház is található, amelyek közül néhány ma is magántulajdonban van. A helyi gazdaság ma már főként a szolgáltatásokra és az Ashford International állomás közelségéből adódó ingázásra épül, miközben a környék kirándulóhelyei népszerűek a természetjárók körében.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Kennington este o suburbie elegantă și plină de istorie a orașului Ashford, situată în comitatul Kent, supranumit 'Grădina Angliei'. Istoria sa este documentată încă din perioada normandă, când a fost înregistrat ca domeniu regal sub numele de Chenentone. Localitatea este așezată pe pantele line ale Văii Stour, oferind priveliști pitorești și acces direct la rutele de plimbare din regiunea Kent Downs. Inima istorică a satului este marcată de Biserica Sfânta Maria, o structură medievală care păstrează elemente arhitecturale de o valoare deosebită. Din punct de vedere economic, Kennington a beneficiat masiv de dezvoltarea orașului Ashford ca nod de transport internațional, devenind o locație rezidențială de top pentru profesioniștii care caută liniște fără a sacrifica conectivitatea. Comunitatea se mândrește cu facilități locale excelente, inclusiv terenuri de cricket tradiționale și pub-uri istorice, care mențin viu spiritul autentic al satului englezesc, în ciuda expansiunii urbane moderne din jur.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Kennington is a desirable residential area and former village located on the northeastern outskirts of Ashford in Kent. Its name, derived from the Old English for 'the king's town', reflects its status as a royal manor during the Middle Ages, as confirmed by its entry in the Domesday Book. The area is defined by its position in the Great Stour valley, which provides a natural green buffer between the suburb and the industrial parts of Ashford. At the core of Kennington lies the Grade II listed St Mary’s Church, a fine example of 13th-century architecture that continues to serve as a focal point for local heritage. Throughout the 20th century, Kennington expanded significantly, transitioning from a rural farming community to a prime commuter location due to its proximity to the M20 motorway and Ashford International station. Despite this growth, it retains its village atmosphere through a network of footpaths, local cricket clubs, and well-preserved buildings such as the historic public houses. Today, it stands as a testament to the balance between modern suburban living and the preservation of Kentish rural history.

ro.a: Da, este renumită pentru școlile bune și numeroasele spații verzi.
Deși nu are gară proprie, Ashford International este la doar câțiva kilometri distanță.

en.q: Is this the same Kennington as the one in London?
en.a: No, this is Kennington near Ashford in Kent, distinct from the London district.

en.q: What is the primary landmark in Kennington?
en.a: The medieval St Mary's Church is the area's most famous landmark.

en.q: Is there access to local parks?
en.a: Yes, Ball Lane Park and the nearby Stour Valley paths are popular for recreation.

en.q: How is the connection to the M20?
en.a: Kennington has very easy access to Junction 9 and 10 of the M20 motorway.
